name: What are the best moisture-resistant flooring options for basements?

mainEntity.name: What are the best moisture-resistant flooring options for basements?

acceptedAnswer.text: For basements prone to moisture, several flooring options offer high resistance. Luxury vinyl plank (LVP) and luxury vinyl tile (LVT) are excellent choices as they are fully waterproof and highly durable. Ceramic and porcelain tiles are also impermeable to water, making them ideal for areas with potential spills or higher humidity. Sheet vinyl is another cost-effective, fully waterproof option. When installing any flooring in a basement, always ensure the subfloor is properly prepared with a moisture barrier if needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: LVP, LVT, ceramic/porcelain tile, and sheet vinyl are highly moisture-resistant. Always ensure proper subfloor preparation and moisture barriers.
